missing_requirements: The public documents establish local source/template advice, not complete collector receiver acceptance. All new findings are warnings.
Legacy extraction decodes value-bearing query names/values once and omits bare keys. Unknown parameters and macros remain open. No universal receiver duplicate first/last policy is claimed.

Top-level query contracts also use the existing form-body fallback for complete captures. Query fields take precedence by name. Native JSON body members do not satisfy these contracts. This local carrier behavior does not prove receiver POST/form support.
Directory roots attribute child subdomains, while each endpoint manifest selects only its explicit host and path. Unsupported attributed routes receive directory.no_rulepack_coverage info.

No live collector requests, private sample values, campaign/account state, delivery or platform configuration were used. Fixtures derive from public templates and synthetic boundaries; they are not executed vendor SDK captures.
Six active advisories cover presence of pr,adn,ca,si,pl,cr shared by ART19,Nativo and PRX templates. Those common names do not establish a closed receiver schema or mandatory server rejection.
All13 mapped field names are inventory; optional opaque did,ord,tt,a,gdpr,gdpr_consent,us_privacy add no new value constraints. Empty/custom/encoded metadata and unknown extras remain open.

Nativo is a distinct valid public producer variant: ca is numeric,cr is native,and did/ord/privacy fields are absent. ART19 uses a UUID-shaped ca and blank privacy carriers. No universal numeric/UUID grammar or optional-field requiredness is inferred.

ART19 forwarding headers and double-brace macros are podcast-platform configuration. PRX uses randomint and dollar consent macros. No universal header,macro,method,MIME,timestamp,freshness or cache-buster law is imposed.
PRX deliberately appends .example to prevent bots. Its actual Dynata host is corroborated independently by ART19 and Nativo. The pack never selects the .example hostname.

A PRX GDPR_CONSENT_110 placeholder is not sufficient evidence for universal Dynata vendor/purpose consent bits. Standard populated privacy checks remain in core; no Lucid vendor508 rule is transferred.

Exact receiver field meanings, required/optional matrix, conditional privacy requirements, accepted value registries, encoding rules, duplicate precedence and transport contract remain unavailable in the inspected public article bodies.

The official help sitemap exposes relevant Brand Lift article URLs, but four normal public GETs returned the identical JavaScript shell rather than article bodies. This is a rendering/access gap, not proof the documentation does not exist.
The public Dynata GitHub repository index did not bind survey/rewards/demand APIs to /t/beacon. Unrelated SDK field contracts were not reused.
proof_scope: Public template substitutions and independently authored boundaries. No unchanged vendor producer source is publicly bound here.
